reference_evidence_units.subject: N1-Me and N2-Me
reference_evidence_units.statement: Ultrafast (~200 fs) ESIPT in both methylated analogues.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Further support is provided by calculations on N2-Me(b)

reference_evidence_units.limitations: Calculation only; the conformer population is inferred from NMR.
